Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study consists of two parts: a basal cytosolic proteome analysis and a PCNA interactome analysis via co-immunoprecipitation (AP-MS). Quantification was performed using spectral counting (LFQ). While the text mentions phosphorylation (p-STAT1) and citrullination (Cit-H3) in the context of immunofluorescence and PLA, the PRIDE metadata lists phosphorylated and acetylated residues as identified PTMs in the MS data.

organism: Data were searched against the SwissProt Human database (v2021-02)
cell_types: Proteomic analyses were performed on neutrophil cytosols
noncellular_sources: Blood samples from COVID-19 patients and from healthy donors (HDs) obtained from the Etablissement Francais du Sang were collected in EDTA-vacuum tubes.
scope: PCNA was immunoprecipitated in the cytosol of neutrophils (either from HD or from COVID-19 patients) using a rabbit polyclonal anti-PCNA (Ab5).
For interactome analyses, PCNA was immunoprecipitated in the cytosol of two patients’ neutrophils using a rabbit polyclonal anti-PCNA (Ab5) using Miltenyi magnetic beads

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment focuses on the comparison of neutrophil cytosols across three clinical groups: healthy donors, severe COVID-19, and critical COVID-19. While the text describes in vitro experiments using T2AA (PCNA inhibitor) and IFN stimulation, these were validated via RT-qPCR, ELISA, and imaging, not via the mass spectrometry proteomics analysis described in the Methods and Results sections. Therefore, T2AA and IFN are not listed as primary biological variables for the MS dataset.
